Question 38

Given that y=y(x) satisfies the equation y″+4y′+20y=0, which of the following is not a solution to this equation?

a
5e−2xcos⁡4x
b
4e−2x+e−2xsin⁡4x
c
−2e−2xsin⁡4x
d
e−2xcos⁡4x−3e−2xsin⁡4x
e
3e−2xcos⁡4x−8e−2xsin⁡4x
Don't Know
